elements.name: ntl-card-row
elements.description: Responsive row layout for nte-card components.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Cards or sections rendered as cards.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Current responsive mode reflected by BreakPointMixin.

classes.name: highlight
classes.description: Raised card modifier for direct nte-card children.

classes.name: with-borderless-cards
classes.description: Demo/theme modifier: removes border and inner padding from all direct nte-card children via with-borderless-cards().

classes.name: with-item-separators
classes.description: Demo/theme modifier: adds separator pseudo-elements between direct nte-card children via with-item-separators().

classes.name: with-horizontal-flow
classes.description: Enables the opt-in native horizontal card flow in mobile mode; desktop keeps the 12-column layout.

classes.name: footer-separators
classes.description: Adds desktop separators between direct nte-card children.

properties.name: --visible-cols-mobile
properties.description: Number of cards visible in the mobile horizontal flow. Default: 1.15; values below 1 are clamped to 1.

properties.name: --horizontal-flow-gap
properties.description: Inline gap between cards in the mobile horizontal flow. Default: var(--gutter-x).

properties.name: --horizontal-flow-snap
properties.description: Native horizontal scroll-snap strength. Default: proximity.
